logs.detail: Primary distribution loop fully operational. All seven sectors receiving nominal flow.
Filtration stage 3 membrane replaced ahead of schedule. Throughput restored to 94% efficiency.
Annual reservoir integrity check passed. No micro-fractures detected in containment walls.
Assumed distribution responsibility for sectors previously served by Vault Reserve secondary system. Throughput increased 18%. Operating within rated capacity.
Replaced pump assembly P2-7 with Terminus-fabricated unit. Performance nominal.
Direct feed to Prometheus Lab decommissioned per pipe consolidation project 2093-P4. Prometheus synthesis water now routed through Hydroponics irrigation header. Net flow unchanged.
Distribution control firmware updated to v3.8.1. Improved pressure balancing across loops.
Bi-annual filtration audit complete. All five stages within tolerance. Next scheduled audit 2094-09.
Monthly throughput report: averaging 41,200 L/day against rated capacity of 45,000 L/day. Utilization at 91.6%. Within operational norms.
